banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim with no verifiable backing.

banned.claim: 'Reusable hundreds of times' framed as a zero-waste or zero-impact benefit
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - 'zero impact' style environmental claim without proof.

banned.claim: Saying products are '100% recycled' or made from recycled materials
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - no recycled-content data stated on site to support the claim.

banned.claim: Marketing pads or abrasives as 'carbon neutral' or 'green'
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unqualified carbon claim with no verifiable backing.

banned.claim: 'Relieves hand or wrist fatigue' or any ergonomic health benefit
banned.why: Banned medical claim - implies a health/orthopedic outcome the brand cannot back.

banned.claim: Guaranteeing 'scratch-free on every surface, every time'
banned.why: Absolute performance guarantee not supported by tested proof on site.
